name: Roadlark
subtitle: Signs, rules and mock tests
shortDescription: Practise for the Indian learner's licence test with road signs, traffic rules and timed mock tests. English and Hindi.
longDescription:
Practise for the Indian learner's licence (LL) test with road signs, traffic rules and timed mock tests for cars and two-wheelers. English and Hindi. No account, works offline.

### Road Signs
Browse mandatory, cautionary and informatory signs and drill them with flashcards that bring missed signs back sooner.

### Practice
Topic quizzes (rules of the road, right of way, safe driving, licence and papers, law, two-wheeler rules, emergencies) with a short explanation and the Motor Vehicles Act reference for every answer.

### Mock Tests and Mistakes
20-question timed tests with 12-to-pass scoring in a general practice format, then review every answer. One tap to practise what you got wrong, plus progress by topic.

Free with ads: watch a short ad to earn a mock test, or go ad-free with the monthly subscription. Hindi text is machine-drafted. Roadlark is not affiliated with any government agency and is not an official app; the real learner's licence test is run by your state transport department and can differ in format, language and content.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
